top_signals.title: Andy Burnham signals continuity on UK cyber policy, reappoints minister despite scrapping ministry
top_signals.summary: The new British prime minister is retaining Liz Lloyd in a cyber policy role, making her one of the few Keir Starmer allies remaining in government.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
